confirmed_data.title: Furvise Vet Visit Brief
confirmed_data.disclaimer: Prepared from information recorded by the pet owner in Furvise. It may be incomplete and does not contain a diagnosis or replace veterinary assessment.
confirmed_data.visitSummary: Prednisone was prescribed at 5 mg once daily 9/1-9/5/2026, then 2.5 mg once daily 9/6-9/10/2026; the owner reported itching improved on 9/8 and reported it had returned on 9/12 after the recorded course, with no heavy breathing or weakness reported. Rabies vaccination is documented on 9/13/2023, followed by owner-reported facial swelling that evening that resolved the same evening; no breathing difficulty was recorded. Creatinine was 1.4 mg/dL on 8/28/2026 (reference 0.5-1.6 mg/dL) and 1.1 mg/dL on 6/1/2023 (reference 0.5-1.6 mg/dL); only the 2026 value falls within the requested 2026-06-15 to 2026-09-13 review window.
confirmed_data.reasonForVisit: Owner reports itching returned after prednisone, and wants a vaccination consultation that reviews the prior rabies-vaccine reaction and creatinine results.
